name: prose-author
description: Personal-style writing with explicit rules, advisory corpus tendencies, scoped persistent preferences and exact-final-text checks. Authenticated Claude/Codex runtime; optional whole human examples.

interface.shortDescription: Personal-style writing with checked rules and persistent preferences.
interface.longDescription: Draft, rewrite or continue prose using explicit user preferences, a cited voice-profile/3 and optional selected whole human examples. The dependency-free runner uses existing Claude/Codex CLI authentication, checks exact final bytes, performs task-scaled review and limits repairs to two cycles. Scoped voice-preferences/2 persist with version receipts and undo; inferred preferences require approval. Observed frequencies are advisory, not quotas. Missing checks remain visible. No resemblance, quality or factual-accuracy guarantee.
defaultPrompt: Draft a reply using my writing preferences
Remember this style correction for future replies
Continue this passage without changing its established facts
